purpose: Derive the scalar-shift soft-q scaling of the frozen projectable ADM kinetic sector after s6fG has source-locked the inherited F(t,N) direct shift source to zero. This gate is deliberately narrower than the final ZERO/NONZERO soft-s classification: prove whether the q->0 constraint reduction is regular/finite and identify every term that must be retained before taking q_s=0.

frozen_action_sector.lapse: projectable N=N(t); no local finite-k lapse mode

required_symbolic_checks: derive TrS=-Delta beta-grad(zeta).grad(beta) for S_ij=-beta_ij+Gamma^k_ij beta_k
derive quadratic scalar-shift kernel proportional to (1-lambda_HL) q^4
derive quadratic zeta-beta mixing proportional to -(1-3 lambda_HL) dot(zeta) Delta beta after spatial integration by parts
derive the cubic beta-linear source identity proportional to zeta grad(dot(zeta)).grad(beta)
for hard-hard -> soft kinematics p=-k-q, derive J2(q)=O(q^2), not O(q^0)
derive lim_{q->0} J2/q^2 proportional to -[omega(k)+k v_g(k) mu^2]
show J1=O(q^2), K_beta=O(q^4), hence J1 J2/K_beta=O(q^0) is finite rather than automatically zero
confirm q_s=0 substitution before reduction would erase this finite candidate exchange term
outcome_policy: PASS is a scoped derivation if the scaling and finite-limit statements are established. This gate must not classify the complete reduced cubic vertex as ZERO or NONZERO because cubic beta^2*zeta kernel-variation terms and the explicit alpha6 state-function contribution must still be combined in the next gate.
forbidden: setting q_s=0 before solving the shift constraint
introducing a local finite-k lapse mode
fitting lambda_HL, M_U, M_K or any nonlinear coefficient to obtain cancellation
next_if_pass: C10.65s6fI: derive the complete cubic reduced scalar vertex of MINIMAL_PROJECTABLE_N2_S1HALF_v1 by including the beta^2*zeta kernel variation and alpha6(X) contribution, then evaluate q_s->0 and rerun the unchanged s6fF ZERO/NONZERO semantics.
non_claims: not final soft-s cancellation or survival
not proof the candidate nonlinear branch is unique
